desc: Derive correct closed-form formulas for sum of Manhattan distances over all unordered cell pairs.
Implement modular arithmetic helpers (mod = 1e9+7) and precompute factorials/inverses up to N = m*n.
Compute row_sum = n²·(m³ - m)/6 and col_sum = m²·(n³ - n)/6 modulo mod using inv6 = pow(6, mod-2, mod).
Compute binom = C(N-2, k-2) mod mod.
